description: Bridges is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Sydney. This dataset contains locations of bridges in the City of Sydney by type (pedestrian and vehicular) and owner (those managed by the City of Sydney and those owned by others). Coverage: City of Sydney. The portal files it under the publisher City of Sydney. Its tags are City of Sydney, asset amenity, bridges, transport, transport and access. The portal shows 2025-10-18 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
